definitions.description: The intensity of a status effect on the player (0 when it is not active).

definitions.description: Adds a key binding to every player's server settings and fires when they press it. Players must assign a key or accept the suggested key in settings before first use. Test it while spawned in a round; the waiting-room interface may suppress key input.

definitions.title: On Signal
definitions.description: Fires when any plugin on this server sends a signal with this name. Use it to reuse a chain or to react to another plugin.

definitions.title: Send Signal
definitions.description: Runs every On Signal with this name, in this plugin and in others, then continues.

definitions.title: Branch
definitions.description: Runs True or False depending on the condition.

definitions.title: Random Chance
definitions.description: Runs Success with the given percent chance, Fail otherwise.

definitions.title: Sequence
definitions.description: Runs each output in order, top to bottom.

definitions.title: Delay
definitions.description: Waits some seconds, then runs Completed.

definitions.title: Repeat
definitions.description: Runs Loop Body N times, then Completed.

definitions.title: While
definitions.description: Runs Loop Body again and again while the condition is true, then Completed. Stops after 10000 rounds.

definitions.title: Stop
definitions.description: Stops running this chain.

definitions.description: Random number between min and max.

definitions.title: Random Integer
definitions.description: Random integer from min (inclusive) to max (exclusive).

definitions.title: Round
definitions.description: Rounds to the nearest integer.

definitions.title: Distance
definitions.description: Distance between two positions.

definitions.title: Make Vector3
definitions.description: Builds a position from X, Y and Z.

definitions.title: Break Vector3
definitions.description: Splits a position into X, Y and Z.

definitions.title: AND
definitions.description: True if both are true.

definitions.title: OR
definitions.description: True if either is true.

definitions.title: NOT
definitions.description: Inverts a boolean.

definitions.title: Equals
definitions.description: True if A equals B (roles, teams, items, players, text…).

definitions.title: Not Equals
definitions.description: True if A is different from B.

definitions.title: Is Valid
definitions.description: True if the value exists (e.g. the event has an attacker).

definitions.title: Role Is
definitions.description: True if the role equals the chosen one.

definitions.title: Team Is
definitions.description: True if the team equals the chosen one.

definitions.title: Item Is
definitions.description: True if the item equals the chosen one.

definitions.title: Pick
definitions.description: Gives "If true" when the condition is true and "If false" otherwise. Handy for event outcomes, which cannot use Branch.

definitions.title: Has Flag
definitions.description: True if a combined value (door permissions, keycard permissions…) includes the chosen flag.

definitions.title: Join Text
definitions.description: A + B + C.

definitions.title: Format Text
definitions.description: Replaces {0}, {1} and {2} in the template.

definitions.title: Contains
definitions.description: True if Text contains Search (ignores case).

definitions.title: To Upper
definitions.description: Uppercases text.

definitions.title: To Lower
definitions.description: Lowercases text.

definitions.title: Text Length
definitions.description: How many characters the text has.

definitions.title: Starts With
definitions.description: True if Text starts with Search (ignores case).

definitions.title: Ends With
definitions.description: True if Text ends with Search (ignores case).

definitions.title: Replace Text

definitions.title: Trim Text
definitions.description: Removes spaces from both ends.

definitions.title: Split Text
definitions.description: Splits text into a list at every separator. Empty parts are dropped.

definitions.title: Color Text

definitions.title: Zone

definitions.title: Integer To Number
definitions.description: Turns an integer into a decimal number.

definitions.description: Turns a decimal number into an integer by dropping the decimals (2.9 → 2).

definitions.title: Text To Number
definitions.description: Reads a number from text. "Is Number" is false (and the number 0) when the text is not a number.

definitions.description: Runs Loop Body once for each entry in the list, then Completed.

definitions.title: Count
definitions.description: How many entries the list has.

definitions.title: Random Entry
definitions.description: A random entry from the list (empty if the list is empty).

definitions.title: First Entry
definitions.description: The first entry of the list (empty if the list is empty).

definitions.title: Entry At
definitions.description: The entry at the index, counting from 0 (empty if there is none).

definitions.title: Is Empty
definitions.description: True if the list has no entries.

definitions.title: Add To List
definitions.description: A copy of the list with the value added at the end. Store it back with a set node to keep it.

definitions.title: Remove From List
definitions.description: A copy of the list without the value. Store it back with a set node to keep it.

definitions.title: Contains
definitions.description: True if the list contains the value.

Player.doc: The wrapper representing reference hubs, the in-game players.

BulkheadDoor.doc: The wrapper representing the PryableDoor used for the bulkhead prefab instance.

Structure.doc: The wrapper over the SpawnableStructure object.
